DBA corrects per-model bias before combining; with unstable ranking (tau=0.064) but potentially stable individual biases, this tests a different mechanism than median/trimmed_mean.

Test whether inverse-error weighting on the full 19-model pool beats the robust median; with 7 correlated groups and unstable rankings, weighting may overfit, but if top models are consistently better it should help.
One model per correlation group (7 groups) to test whether reducing correlated redundancy while keeping diversity beats full-pool median
Per-horizon top-5 SMAPE weighting to exploit unstable cross-window ranking; different models may dominate at different steps within the 8-step horizon.
Median within a metric-ranked top-7 pool: tests whether a tighter robust pool beats full-pool median under unstable rankings

Per-horizon one-hot weights: tests whether letting each of the 8 horizon steps pick its own single best model adapts better to the unstable ranking (tau=0.064) than top-k averaging (w3). Different kind from median/trimmed_mean/DBA already tested.
Caruana forward selection to find complementary models under high error correlation (0.841) and unstable rankings; different from inverse_error and best_per_horizon which just rank by raw error

Smooth softmax weighting as a contrast to the hard best_per_horizon leader; tests whether gentle error-based differentiation outperforms both uniform (median) and fully discrete (one-hot) schemes under unstable rankings

Robust trimmed mean on the curated 6-7 model pool: trims worst ~1 model, testing whether robustness on a tighter diverse pool beats full-pool median and per-horizon weighted under unstable rankings (tau=0.064)
Simplest untried robust baseline: arithmetic mean over all 19 models, testing whether mean vs median differs under low predictability and unstable rankings

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.892. Series context: trend strength 0.9996 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.064); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.02.
